compiler.input: Exact REQUESTED_COUNT_V1 freeze and E80 stage request
compiler.output: Fixed argv/env and run-isolated future paths only; no launch API, inherited env, user-selected root or shell
compiler.H: Common Tcl with fixed pattern request
compiler.M_F: Incremental Tcl with mandatory target-native status translation prerequisite; no translation implementation or free helper
compiler.controls: One of PATTERN_LIMIT, TEST_COVERAGE_LIMIT or neither FULL, never both
compiler.source_identity: Intended Tcl source SHA pins match reviewed references, not deployed bytes or Tessent qualification

parser.input: Bounded supplied text strings only; no actual report file access
checks: postFU equals declared full common count
bounded integer TesterCycle maximum without silently truncating numeric suffixes, reported as ATE cycles only
exact stage/run/mode and requested-control Tcl marker dialect
incremental preFU equals declared full common count

budget.rule: Reserve exact ordered slot before token; STATUS_TRANSLATION and TESSENT_STAGE consume separate counters/envelopes; same task binding cannot be renamed or consumed twice
budget.failure: No refunds or retry; failed tasks stop, unresolved completion/elapsed/cleanup poisons subsequent slots, observed envelope overrun retained and stops
budget.asserted_elapsed_scope: Known settled prefix only, not full session or authenticated ATPG time
budget.recreation: Recreating a RAM object resets state; not a restart/resume or durable quota mechanism

synthetic_connection: Known fabricated reports and parent hashes are fixtures; parsing/debit success is not physical translation, process execution or data validation
remaining_actual_dependencies: authenticated target-native translation and fault mapping
real process launcher and memory/time/output guards
durable budget admission and adaptive request late binding
separate whole execution package and authority
